rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE SECURE PENDING BOX // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Imagine Container — Imagine a container whose lock, size, material, and location feel credible.
2. Place Cannot — Place only what cannot be processed now inside it.
3. Name Stored — Name what is stored and when it will be revisited, ideally with support.
4. Close Container — Close the container and reorient to today’s next task.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Close Container be enough.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Imagine Container, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At Name Stored, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Close Container, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: Unfinished material needs a boundary, not denial.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A believable refuge works better than fantasy pressure.

GAME MOVE
One round only: enter at Place Five, finish at Strengthen.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 BUILD SAFE-ENOUGH, NOT PERFECT // PLAY
Follow the sequence once; leave the rest alone.

1. Place Five — Construct a place using five sensory facts and one control feature: an exit, boundary, companion, or adjustable distance.
2. Rehearse Specific — Rehearse entering through a specific cue and leaving on purpose.
3. Strengthen — Strengthen the detail that produces the clearest bodily yes.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Strengthen and release the exercise.

2. At Rehearse Specific, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Strengthen, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Your takeaway: A believable refuge works better than fantasy pressure.

rituals.title: ONE-WORD LIGHT TOUCH
rituals.name: ONE-WORD LIGHT TOUCH
rituals.unique_game_move: Start with Apply Quiet. When Name Producing appears, the round is over.
rituals.recognition_cue: If your mind is acting as if there will never be enough, One-Word Light Touch turns the mental noise into one playable move.
rituals.situation: If your mind is acting as if there will never be enough, One-Word Light Touch turns the mental noise into one playable move.
rituals.immediate_need: Name enough to see; not enough to build a story.
rituals.challenge: Name enough to see; not enough to build a story.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Values, meaning & loss

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
If your mind is acting as if there will never be enough, One-Word Light Touch turns the mental noise into one playable move.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Name enough to see; not enough to build a story.

GAME MOVE
Start with Apply Quiet. When Name Producing appears, the round is over.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 ONE-WORD LIGHT TOUCH // PLAY
Play it once. No bonus analysis.

1. Apply Quiet — As events arise, apply a quiet category: hearing, planning, heat, remembering, pressure.
2. Use Word — Use one word once, then return to the raw event.
3. Name Producing — If a Name starts producing analysis, Name that ‘explaining’ and release it.

⚡ END MOVE — Name Producing. No second lap.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Just before you start Apply Quiet, notice one sound in the room before continuing.
2. At Use Word, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Name Producing, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Use this as the exit rule: Name enough to see; not enough to build a story.

rituals.win_reward:
🏆 WIN SIGNAL
Something shifts enough that Name Producing feels like a real option.

📸 MY RESULT
“I just separated 'not enough right now' from 'never enough.'”
rituals.formula_flow: Apply Quiet → Use Word → Name Producing
rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Drop noting if labels become compulsive, critical, or distancing.

rituals.unique_game_move: Start at Pick Word and keep going only until Jump Letter.
rituals.recognition_cue: Break The Night'S Storyline is for the moment when one moment is turning into a whole story—before the reaction gets to choose for you.
rituals.situation: Break The Night'S Storyline is for the moment when one moment is turning into a whole story—before the reaction gets to choose for you.
rituals.immediate_need: Sleep does not need another storyline to solve.
rituals.challenge: Sleep does not need another storyline to solve.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Rigid beliefs, labels & stories

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Break The Night'S Storyline is for the moment when one moment is turning into a whole story—before the reaction gets to choose for you.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Sleep does not need another storyline to solve.

GAME MOVE
Start at Pick Word and keep going only until Jump Letter.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 BREAK THE NIGHT'S STORYLINE // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Pick Word — Choose one harmless five-letter word, such as TABLE. Use each letter once; there is no need to finish perfectly.
2. Call Object — For the first letter, name a neutral object beginning with it—T for tree, for example.
3. Flash Image — Picture that object for about two seconds with no action, meaning, memory, or story.
4. Jump Letter — Jump to the next letter and a completely unrelated object. End after five letters; do not score sleep.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Jump Letter is your cue to stop.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. As you enter Pick Word, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
2. At Flash Image, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Jump Letter, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The round ends on this idea: Sleep does not need another storyline to solve.

Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

TRIGGER

PLAY TIME

HOOK
When good enough is being rejected unless it is flawless, Make The First Move Deliberately Wrong makes the invisible part of the pattern easier to catch.

GOAL
A throwaway mistake can make the blank page lose its authority.

GAME MOVE
Use Throwaway as the doorway and Continue Clean as the exit.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MAKE THE FIRST MOVE DELIBERATELY WRONG // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Throwaway — Open a private sandbox and Notice your mental picture THROWAWAY—NOT FOR SENDING.
2. Make Wrong — Create one obviously imperfect start: a clumsy sentence, rough title, ugly Imagine, or incomplete outline.
3. Fix One — Correct exactly one useful part without polishing the rest.
4. Continue Clean — Keep working only if the task now feels editable; otherwise save the corrected fragment and stop cleanly.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Continue Clean is your cue to stop.

1. As you enter Throwaway, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
2. At Fix One, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Continue Clean, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Let this be the line you keep: A throwaway mistake can make the blank page lose its authority.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You reach Continue Clean without having to solve the entire situation.

“I found the point where enough really was enough.”

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 SOFT DELIVERY, SOLID MESSAGE // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Remove Attacks — Remove attacks from your wording.
2. Validate Understandable — Show one sign of genuine interest, validate the understandable part of the other experience, and use an easy rather than contemptuous manner.
3. Keep Core — Keep your core message unchanged.
4. Edit Delivery — Gentleness edits delivery, not truth.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Edit Delivery and release the exercise.

rituals.plain:
SOFT DELIVERY, SOLID MESSAGE

TRIGGER
Communication & conflict

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Use Soft Delivery, Solid Message when the message in your head has become sharper than the facts. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.

GOAL
Relationship care does not require surrendering the point.

GAME MOVE
Play from Remove Attacks to Edit Delivery. Treat the last move as the finish line.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 SOFT DELIVERY, SOLID MESSAGE // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Remove Attacks — Remove attacks from your wording.
2. Validate Understandable — Show one sign of genuine interest, validate the understandable part of the other experience, and use an easy rather than contemptuous manner.
3. Keep Core — Keep your core message unchanged.
4. Edit Delivery — Gentleness edits delivery, not truth.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Edit Delivery and release the exercise.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Remove Attacks, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Keep Core, ask, “What would count as evidence against my first answer?”.
3. When you reach Edit Delivery, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Take this line with you: Relationship care does not require surrendering the point.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
At Edit Delivery, the next move feels chosen rather than dictated.

📸 MY RESULT
“I just separated what was said from what I added to it.”

FORMULA FLOW
Remove Attacks → Validate Understandable → Keep Core → Edit Delivery

GOAL
A conversation should not corrupt your own values.

GAME MOVE
Let Respond Verify begin the game. Let Speak Extra end it.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 SELF-RESPECT CHECKSUM // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Respond Verify — Before responding, verify four conditions: fair to both sides; no apology for merely existing or setting a limit; aligned with your values; completely truthful.
2. Revise Sentence — Revise any sentence that fails the checksum.
3. Speak Extra — Then speak without extra justification.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Speak Extra and leave the game there.

1. Give yourself one second before Respond Verify: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Revise Sentence, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach Speak Extra, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The round ends on this idea: A conversation should not corrupt your own values.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CARE WITHOUT CARRYING // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Separate Feelings — Name the other person’s feeling and your own current feeling separately.
2. Locate Relative — Locate each relative to your body.
3. Ask Compassionate — Ask what compassionate action is actually yours and what emotional work remains theirs.
4. Offer — Offer the first without absorbing the second.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Offer be enough.

GOAL

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 COOL THE WORDS, KEEP THE FACTS // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Underline — Underline absolutes and inflammatory terms in your account.
2. Observe Behaviour — Exchange every one for a precise factual equivalent: ‘always’ becomes the actual frequency; ‘destroyed’ becomes the specific loss; ‘evil’ becomes the observed behaviour.
3. Read Action — Re-read and notice what action the cooler version supports.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Read Action is your cue to stop.

STAMP THE ENDING INTO THE SENSES

TRIGGER
Grounding & present-moment loss

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
When you have lost contact with the ordinary signals around you, Stamp The Ending Into The Senses helps you test what your mind is telling you.

GOAL
Useful reflection needs a finish signal physiology can recognise.

GAME MOVE
Run the sequence once. Choose A Finish opens it; Close It closes it.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 STAMP THE ENDING INTO THE SENSES // PLAY
Play the moves, not the whole life story.

1. Choose A Finish — Choose one finish you can repeat: wash your hands, hear a soft sound, touch a doorframe, or change the light.
2. Pair It — Pair it with one short answer in your mind and a time to think about it again.
3. Close It — Use the sensory finish only when the topic is truly closed.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Close It, you are done.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Choose A Finish, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Pair It, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Close It, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep the clean version: Useful reflection needs a finish signal physiology can recognise.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
The first interpretation feels less final when you reach Close It.

📸 MY RESULT
“I found the room again through my senses.”

FORMULA FLOW
Choose A Finish → Pair It → Close It

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 RETURN EACH LOAD TO ITS SOURCE // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Estimate Contribution — Name current stressors and estimate each contribution to body alarm.
2. Imagine Arrows — Imagine arrows from the present feeling back to its actual sources.
3. Stop Blaming — Address the largest actionable contributor first; stop blaming the most visible issue for unrelated load.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Stop Blaming, you are done.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Identity claims must show recent action evidence.

GAME MOVE
Run the sequence once. Name Appears opens it; Replace Identity closes it.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 GLOBAL LABELS NEED THREE RECEIPTS // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Name Appears — When ‘I’m lazy,’ ‘I’m unlovable,’ or another global Name appears, demand three specific behaviours from the last month that support it and three that complicate it.
2. Replace Identity — If the evidence is mixed, replace identity with a narrower situational description.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Replace Identity, you are done.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Name Appears, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Replace Identity, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Replace Identity, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep only this lesson: Identity claims must show recent action evidence.

📸 MY RESULT

Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Choose Disliked — Choose the disliked trait.
2. Ask Threat — Ask what threat it once reduced and what payoff maintains it now.
3. Design Alternative — Design one alternative strategy that offers the same protection with lower cost.
4. Test Low — Test it in a low-stakes situation before rewriting identity.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Test Low and release the exercise.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 SAY THE SENTENCE HISTORY NEVER RECEIVED // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Picture Words — Picture the exact words you could not say or hear.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Let It Lead, you are done.

rituals.ritual_name: CHOOSE THE EASIEST MISTAKE TO CATCH
rituals.unique_game_move: Begin where it says Name Options; stop the moment you complete Choose Visible.
rituals.recognition_cue: Choose The Easiest Mistake To Catch catches the moment when a strong feeling is starting to sound like a fact and gives you another route.
rituals.situation: Choose The Easiest Mistake To Catch catches the moment when a strong feeling is starting to sound like a fact and gives you another route.
rituals.immediate_need: A safer choice may be the mistake you can see early enough to correct.
rituals.challenge: A safer choice may be the mistake you can see early enough to correct.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Emotional reasoning

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
Choose The Easiest Mistake To Catch catches the moment when a strong feeling is starting to sound like a fact and gives you another route.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A safer choice may be the mistake you can see early enough to correct.

GAME MOVE
Begin where it says Name Options; stop the moment you complete Choose Visible.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CHOOSE THE EASIEST MISTAKE TO CATCH // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Name Options — Name the two or three live options. For each, Picture the specific way it could fail—not a vague fear.
2. Name Failure — Name the earliest observable sign that failure has begun. It must be visible or clear, not a feeling alone.
3. Warning — State what corrective action would still be available when that sign appears and what cost has already accumulated.
4. Choose Visible — Prefer the option whose reliable warning arrives while correction is still practical. Use this as one decision criterion, not the whole verdict.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Choose Visible be enough.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Name Options, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At Warning, give the feeling a name without letting it make the decision.
3. When you reach Choose Visible, choose one action that fits the facts you found. If you remember one thing, make it this: A safer choice may be the mistake you can see early enough to correct.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 FIND THE MOMENT THE FLOOR CATCHES YOU // PLAY
Play it once. No bonus analysis.

1. Shift Weight — Stand safely and shift weight slowly left, centre, right, then forward and back.
2. Identify Instant — At each transition, spot the exact instant the receiving foot supports you.
3. Finish Centre — Finish at centre and name the strongest contact point.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Finish Centre and release the exercise.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Shift Weight, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Identify Instant, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Finish Centre, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Use this as the exit rule: Panic can obscure support that never disappeared.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 BORROW STILLNESS FROM THE WALL // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Rest Gaze — Rest your gaze on a stable line, corner, or heavy object.
2. Compare Visual — Compare its visual constancy with the motion inside your body and mind.
3. Dont Match — Do not make the inner movement match.
4. Let Facts — Let both facts coexist until the outer reference becomes usable.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Let Facts be enough.

One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Rest Gaze — Rest your gaze on a stable line, corner, or heavy object.
2. Compare Visual — Compare its visual constancy with the motion inside your body and mind.
3. Dont Match — Do not make the inner movement match.
4. Let Facts — Let both facts coexist until the outer reference becomes usable.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Let Facts be enough.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Rest Gaze, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At Dont Match, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Let Facts, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Let an unmoving object prove that movement is not the whole field.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can complete Let Facts without needing perfect certainty first.

📸 MY RESULT
“I found the room again through my senses.”

FORMULA FLOW
Rest Gaze → Compare Visual → Dont Match → Let Facts

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Urgency shrinks when hearing regains depth.

GAME MOVE
One round only: enter at Identify Nearest, finish at Let Far.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 SORT THE SOUNDS BY DISTANCE // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Identify Nearest — Spot the nearest sound, one mid-distance sound, and the farthest audible layer.
2. Move Attention — Move attention outward through those distances, then back once.
3. Let Far — Let the far sound widen the perceived space around the closest one.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Let Far and release the exercise.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Identify Nearest, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Move Attention, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Let Far, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Take this line with you: Urgency shrinks when hearing regains depth.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 HIDE THE OPTION NAMES // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Mask Names — Ask someone—or a shuffled Notice—to rename the leading options A, B and C without showing which is which.
2. Choose Traits — Choose three relevant traits, such as cost, time, fit, reliability, or learning. Keep safety facts visible.
3. Rank Blind — Compare the symbols on those traits without guessing their identities and Hold the current order.
4. Reveal Options — Reveal the names. Keep the blind order or name exactly what Name changed it and why.

⚡ FINISH — Reveal Options closes the round.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Mask Names, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Rank Blind, separate what you know from what you are predicting.
3. When you reach Reveal Options, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: See what the options look like before their names start campaigning.

📸 MY RESULT
“I stopped measuring my whole life against one snapshot.”

1. Mask Names — Ask someone—or a shuffled Notice—to rename the leading options A, B and C without showing which is which.
2. Choose Traits — Choose three relevant traits, such as cost, time, fit, reliability, or learning. Keep safety facts visible.
3. Rank Blind — Compare the symbols on those traits without guessing their identities and Hold the current order.
4. Reveal Options — Reveal the names. Keep the blind order or name exactly what Name changed it and why.

⚡ FINISH — Reveal Options closes the round.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Mask Names, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Rank Blind, separate what you know from what you are predicting.
3. When you reach Reveal Options, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: See what the options look like before their names start campaigning.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can reach Reveal Options with more choice than you had at Mask Names.

📸 MY RESULT
“I stopped measuring my whole life against one snapshot.”

Mask Names → Choose Traits → Rank Blind → Reveal Options

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL

GAME MOVE
Run the sequence once. Picture Expiry opens it; Expired closes it.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 WHEN DOES THIS INFORMATION EXPIRE? // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Picture Expiry — For each influential input, Picture an expiry condition: price changes, role ends, policy updates, health status shifts, deadline passes.
2. Expired — Notice expired items visually and prevent them from guiding new behaviour until refreshed.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Expired, you are done.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Picture Expiry, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Expired, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Expired, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Remember the point: Data should not remain active after its conditions disappear.

rituals.title: MOVE BEFORE MOTIVATION
rituals.name: MOVE BEFORE MOTIVATION
rituals.unique_game_move: Start at Begin Anyway. Stop at Test Momentum. Let the middle do the work.
rituals.recognition_cue: Move Before Motivation gives you a quick reset for the moment when a strong feeling is starting to sound like a fact.
rituals.situation: Move Before Motivation gives you a quick reset for the moment when a strong feeling is starting to sound like a fact.
rituals.immediate_need: Feeling ready is not a legal requirement for the first motion.
rituals.challenge: Feeling ready is not a legal requirement for the first motion.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Emotional reasoning

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Move Before Motivation gives you a quick reset for the moment when a strong feeling is starting to sound like a fact.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Feeling ready is not a legal requirement for the first motion.

GAME MOVE
Start at Begin Anyway. Stop at Test Momentum. Let the middle do the work.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MOVE BEFORE MOTIVATION // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Begin Anyway — State honestly: ‘Motivation may stay absent.’ Begin the earliest physical component anyway—stand, open, carry, type, dial.
2. Complete Unit — Continue only through one contained unit.
3. Test Momentum — Let action provide data about whether more is possible.

⚡ FINISH — Test Momentum closes the round.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Begin Anyway, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Complete Unit, give the feeling a name without letting it make the decision.
3. When you reach Test Momentum, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: Feeling ready is not a legal requirement for the first motion.

rituals.potency_2: At Complete Unit, give the feeling a name without letting it make the decision.
rituals.potency_3: When you reach Test Momentum, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: Feeling ready is not a legal requirement for the first motion.
rituals.win_reward:
🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can hold the discomfort and still make the move at Test Momentum.

📸 MY RESULT
“The feeling was real. It still wasn't the whole evidence.”
rituals.formula_flow: Begin Anyway → Complete Unit → Test Momentum

GOAL
Difficulty can signal growth, danger, novelty, or bad design.

GAME MOVE
Start at Use Evidence and keep going only until Respond Category.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 WHAT KIND OF EFFORT IS THIS? // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Use Evidence — Classify the strain using evidence.
2. Stop Novelty — If danger, stop; if novelty, allow learning; if skill growth, dose it; if poor design, simplify the system.
3. Respond Category — Respond to the category instead of interpreting all effort as failure.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Respond Category is your cue to stop.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. As you enter Use Evidence, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
2. At Stop Novelty, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Respond Category, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Let this be the line you keep: Difficulty can signal growth, danger, novelty, or bad design.

TRIGGER
Uncertainty & reassurance seeking

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
Use Three Incompatible Readings when not knowing feels like something you must fix immediately. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.

GOAL
Uncertainty is not evidence for your favourite meaning.

GAME MOVE
Start with Hold Cue. When Receive Support appears, the round is over.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THREE INCOMPATIBLE READINGS // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Hold Cue — Hold the same cue—a delayed reply, expression, result.
2. Identify Future — Generate three explanations that cannot all be true and spot what future evidence would discriminate among them.
3. Receive Support — Delay commitment until one prediction receives support.

⚡ END MOVE — Receive Support. No second lap.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Just before you start Hold Cue, notice one sound in the room before continuing.
2. At Identify Future, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Receive Support, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Take this line with you: Uncertainty is not evidence for your favourite meaning.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
At Receive Support, you have at least one option the first reaction did not show you.

📸 MY RESULT
“I just left one question unanswered and stayed okay enough.”

FORMULA FLOW
Hold Cue → Identify Future → Receive Support

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Perceiver and perceived need not stay rigidly opposed.

GAME MOVE
Run the sequence once. Choose Simple opens it; Let Relationship closes it.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 SOFTEN BOTH SIDES OF SEEING // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Choose Simple — Choose a simple object or sound.
2. Attend Time — Attend at the same time to its qualities and the act of perceiving.
3. Place Reality — Refuse to place all reality on either side.
4. Let Relationship — Let the relationship event—seeing or hearing—become primary for several seconds.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Let Relationship, you are done.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Choose Simple, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Place Reality, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Let Relationship, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Remember the point: Perceiver and perceived need not stay rigidly opposed.

rituals.potency_3: When you reach Let Relationship, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Remember the point: Perceiver and perceived need not stay rigidly opposed.
rituals.win_reward:
🏆 WIN SIGNAL
The move at Let Relationship feels more deliberate than automatic.

📸 MY RESULT
“I noticed the thought without becoming the thought.”
rituals.formula_flow: Choose Simple → Attend Time → Place Reality → Let Relationship

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 WHAT MATERIAL CONSEQUENCE DOES STATUS ACTUALLY HAVE? // PLAY
Follow the sequence once; leave the rest alone.

1. Describe Status — Say the status loss without prestige language.
2. Name — Name actual effects on income, access, authority, relationship, and safety.
3. Separate Embarrassment — Separate those from embarrassment or comparison.
4. Respond Proportionately — Respond proportionately to the material column.

⚡ END MOVE — Respond Proportionately. No second lap.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Unfinished material needs a boundary, not denial.

GAME MOVE
Open at Imagine Container; close at Close Container. Keep it light and literal.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE SECURE PENDING BOX // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Imagine Container — Imagine a container whose lock, size, material, and location feel credible.
2. Place Cannot — Place only what cannot be processed now inside it.
3. Name Stored — Name what is stored and when it will be revisited, ideally with support.
4. Close Container — Close the container and reorient to today’s next task.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Close Container be enough.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Imagine Container, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At Name Stored, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Close Container, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: Unfinished material needs a boundary, not denial.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A believable refuge works better than fantasy pressure.

GAME MOVE
One round only: enter at Place Five, finish at Strengthen.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 BUILD SAFE-ENOUGH, NOT PERFECT // PLAY
Follow the sequence once; leave the rest alone.

1. Place Five — Construct a place using five sensory facts and one control feature: an exit, boundary, companion, or adjustable distance.
2. Rehearse Specific — Rehearse entering through a specific cue and leaving on purpose.
3. Strengthen — Strengthen the detail that produces the clearest bodily yes.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Strengthen and release the exercise.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Place Five, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Rehearse Specific, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Strengthen, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Your takeaway: A believable refuge works better than fantasy pressure.

TRIGGER

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Try Build Safe-Enough, Not Perfect when an old danger is crowding into the present. It creates just enough space for a different response.

GOAL
A believable refuge works better than fantasy pressure.

GAME MOVE
One round only: enter at Place Five, finish at Strengthen.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 BUILD SAFE-ENOUGH, NOT PERFECT // PLAY
Follow the sequence once; leave the rest alone.

1. Place Five — Construct a place using five sensory facts and one control feature: an exit, boundary, companion, or adjustable distance.
2. Rehearse Specific — Rehearse entering through a specific cue and leaving on purpose.
3. Strengthen — Strengthen the detail that produces the clearest bodily yes.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Strengthen and release the exercise.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Place Five, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Rehearse Specific, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Strengthen, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Your takeaway: A believable refuge works better than fantasy pressure.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
By the time you reach Strengthen, the problem looks a little more workable.

📸 MY RESULT
“The alarm came from then; I found evidence of now.”

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CLOSE THE MICRO-GAPS // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Choose Precise — Choose an anchor and notice the precise moment contact breaks.

3. Track Interval — Track the interval between noticing and reconnection.
4. Let Practice — Let practice end after one stretch with visibly fewer or shorter gaps.

⚡ DONE — Complete Let Practice, then return to your day.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Sleep does not need another storyline to solve.

GAME MOVE
Start at Pick Word and keep going only until Jump Letter.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 BREAK THE NIGHT'S STORYLINE // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Pick Word — Choose one harmless five-letter word, such as TABLE. Use each letter once; there is no need to finish perfectly.
2. Call Object — For the first letter, name a neutral object beginning with it—T for tree, for example.
3. Flash Image — Picture that object for about two seconds with no action, meaning, memory, or story.
4. Jump Letter — Jump to the next letter and a completely unrelated object. End after five letters; do not score sleep.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Jump Letter is your cue to stop.

2. At Flash Image, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Jump Letter, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The round ends on this idea: Sleep does not need another storyline to solve.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE ACTION HAD MANY AUTHORS // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Name Conditions — Review one action and name its conditions: intention, habit, body capacity, other people, tools, timing, culture, and chance.
2. Place Yourself — Place yourself among these causes rather than above them.
3. Keep Responsibility — Keep responsibility for your contribution while releasing sole authorship.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Keep Responsibility, you are done.

items.trigger_play_time:

Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Ally Or Saboteur? is a tiny mind game for the moment when your mind keeps delaying the first move.
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Judge the mental move by how it treats your life.

GAME MOVE
Run the sequence once. Ask Thought opens it; Thank Warning closes it.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 ALLY OR SABOTEUR? // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Ask Thought — Ask the current thought three questions: Does it clarify the next move?
2. Check Protection — Does it protect something real?
3. Leave Me — Does it leave me more capable afterward?
4. Score Yes — Score each yes or no.
5. Thank Warning — If it fails two, thank the warning and appoint a different inner adviser.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Thank Warning, you are done.

2. At Leave Me, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Thank Warning, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep only this lesson: Judge the mental move by how it treats your life.

GOAL
Relationship care does not require surrendering the point.

Play from Remove Attacks to Edit Delivery. Treat the last move as the finish line.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 SOFT DELIVERY, SOLID MESSAGE // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Remove Attacks — Remove attacks from your wording.
2. Validate Understandable — Show one sign of genuine interest, validate the understandable part of the other experience, and use an easy rather than contemptuous manner.
3. Keep Core — Keep your core message unchanged.
4. Edit Delivery — Gentleness edits delivery, not truth.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Edit Delivery and release the exercise.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A conversation should not corrupt your own values.

GAME MOVE
Let Respond Verify begin the game. Let Speak Extra end it.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 SELF-RESPECT CHECKSUM // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Respond Verify — Before responding, verify four conditions: fair to both sides; no apology for merely existing or setting a limit; aligned with your values; completely truthful.
2. Revise Sentence — Revise any sentence that fails the checksum.
3. Speak Extra — Then speak without extra justification.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Speak Extra and leave the game there.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Give yourself one second before Respond Verify: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Revise Sentence, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach Speak Extra, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The round ends on this idea: A conversation should not corrupt your own values.

Play it once. No bonus analysis.

1. State Triggering — State the triggering condition, your limit, the action you will take, and when you will take it.
2. Remove Threats — Remove threats that depend on the other person changing.
3. Practise Line — Practise the line once at speaking volume, then prepare the consequence before delivery.

⚡ END MOVE — Practise Line. No second lap.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Just before you start State Triggering, notice one sound in the room before continuing.
2. At Remove Threats, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach Practise Line, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Use this as the exit rule: A boundary becomes real when follow-through is inside your control.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
Something shifts enough that Practise Line feels like a real option.

📸 MY RESULT
“I just found where my responsibility ends.”

State Triggering → Remove Threats → Practise Line

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Give the feeling space without sending it to the other person.

GAME MOVE
Begin with See The Person. Move straight through to Wait—no extra analysing.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 SAY IT IN YOUR MIND. DO NOT SEND IT. // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. See The Person — Imagine the person in front of you.
2. Say What Happened — In your mind, say what happened, what you felt, what you needed, and what you now choose to release.
3. Do Not Edit — Let the message be honest, but do not plan harm.
4. Wait — Do not contact the person for twenty-four hours. Let the message stay only in your mind.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Wait and leave the game there.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Give yourself one second before See The Person: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Do Not Edit, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Wait, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Let this be the line you keep: Give the feeling space without sending it to the other person.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE TWENTY-MINUTE TRUTH STORY // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Set A Time — Choose up to twenty minutes.
2. Tell The Story — In your mind, move through what happened, what you felt, and what it means now.
3. Come Back To Now — End by naming where you are, what day it is, and one caring action you can take.
4. Repeat Only If Helpful — Try again on another day only if it helps.

⚡ DONE — Complete Repeat Only If Helpful, then return to your day.

items.unique_game_move: Move through the sequence once, from Picture Prediction to Remove Vote.
items.recognition_cue: Cross Out The Expired Future gives you a quick reset for the moment when your mind is speaking as if it already knows what happens next.

items.challenge: A forecast should lose influence when its decision window closes.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Catastrophic prediction

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Cross Out The Expired Future gives you a quick reset for the moment when your mind is speaking as if it already knows what happens next.
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A forecast should lose influence when its decision window closes.

GAME MOVE
Move through the sequence once, from Picture Prediction to Remove Vote.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CROSS OUT THE EXPIRED FUTURE // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Picture Prediction — Picture the prediction and the exact condition that makes it obsolete: date passed, result known, action completed, evidence changed.
2. Imagine Line — When that condition arrives, Imagine a line through the forecast and Picture EXPIRED.
3. Remove Vote — It may remain historically visible, but it receives no further vote.

⚡ FINISH — Remove Vote closes the round.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Picture Prediction, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Imagine Line, find one fact that does not fit the loudest story.
3. When you reach Remove Vote, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: A forecast should lose influence when its decision window closes.

📸 MY RESULT

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 TURN ANTICIPATION INTO INVENTORY // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Repeat Extract — Each time the same future scene repeats, extract one actionable item: question, document, rehearsal, route, support, or if-then link.
2. Add Checklist — Add it to a checklist.
3. Stamp Simulation — When repetition yields no new preparation, stamp the simulation PAID IN FULL and switch to execution.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Stamp Simulation and release the exercise.

2. At Add Checklist, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Stamp Simulation, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Take this line with you: Body alarm earns its keep only through preparation.

items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Imagine receiving this ordinary day back.

GAME MOVE
Touch Picture, follow the moves, and finish on Choose Behaviour.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE LIFE RETURNED TEST // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Picture — Picture having lost access to your current life and unexpectedly waking inside it again.
2. Small — What small feature would suddenly matter—someone’s voice, a body ability, unfinished work, morning light?
3. Choose Behaviour — Choose one behaviour that honours that recovered value today, without romanticising real hardship.

⚡ DONE — Complete Choose Behaviour, then return to your day.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. At the start of Picture, widen your gaze and notice the edges of the room.
2. At Small, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Choose Behaviour, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Remember the point: Imagine receiving this ordinary day back.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 A NOTE FROM TOMORROW MORNING // PLAY
Play it once. No bonus analysis.

1. Picture Tomorrow — Picture as tomorrow-you, after tonight’s urge has passed: ‘Please protect at least…’ Name one minimum—sleep, money, sobriety, dignity, preparation, or safety.
2. Date Sign — Sign with tomorrow’s date.
3. Put — Put the contract where the immediate choice occurs.

⚡ END MOVE — Put. No second lap.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 LOOK FOR THE MISSING DANGER // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

items.plain:
STAMP THE ENDING INTO THE SENSES

TRIGGER
Grounding & present-moment loss

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
When you have lost contact with the ordinary signals around you, Stamp The Ending Into The Senses helps you test what your mind is telling you.

GOAL
Useful reflection needs a finish signal physiology can recognise.

GAME MOVE
Run the sequence once. Choose A Finish opens it; Close It closes it.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 STAMP THE ENDING INTO THE SENSES // PLAY
Play the moves, not the whole life story.

1. Choose A Finish — Choose one finish you can repeat: wash your hands, hear a soft sound, touch a doorframe, or change the light.
2. Pair It — Pair it with one short answer in your mind and a time to think about it again.
3. Close It — Use the sensory finish only when the topic is truly closed.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Close It, you are done.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Choose A Finish, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Pair It, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Close It, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep the clean version: Useful reflection needs a finish signal physiology can recognise.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
The first interpretation feels less final when you reach Close It.

📸 MY RESULT
“I found the room again through my senses.”

FORMULA FLOW
Choose A Finish → Pair It → Close It

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Intensity is a photograph; momentum is the film.

GAME MOVE
Start at Hold In Your Mind Level. Stop at Make Decisions. Let the middle do the work.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MEASURE THE EMOTION’S VELOCITY // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Hold In Your Mind Level — At three intervals, Keep not only level but direction and speed: rising fast, steady, falling slowly.
2. Add Action — Add the action impulse at each point.
3. Make Decisions — Make decisions from trajectory plus facts, not from the first intensity number alone.

⚡ FINISH — Make Decisions closes the round.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Hold In Your Mind Level, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Add Action, give the feeling a name without letting it make the decision.
3. When you reach Make Decisions, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Intensity is a photograph; momentum is the film.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 RETURN EACH LOAD TO ITS SOURCE // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Estimate Contribution — Name current stressors and estimate each contribution to body alarm.

GOAL
Emotion maintains itself through tempo as well as story.

GAME MOVE
Move through the sequence once, from Cadence to Observe Emotional.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CHANGE THE RHYTHM, CHANGE THE STATE // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Cadence — Notice the cadence of speech, movement, or breathing.
2. Choose Opposite — Choose an opposite rhythm: agitated becomes deliberate, collapsed becomes lightly brisk, looping becomes irregular.
3. Observe Emotional — Maintain the new tempo through one simple task and observe the emotional shift.

⚡ FINISH — Observe Emotional closes the round.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Cadence, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Choose Opposite, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Observe Emotional, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: Emotion maintains itself through tempo as well as story.

GOAL

GAME MOVE
Run the sequence once. Name Appears opens it; Replace Identity closes it.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 GLOBAL LABELS NEED THREE RECEIPTS // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Name Appears — When ‘I’m lazy,’ ‘I’m unlovable,’ or another global Name appears, demand three specific behaviours from the last month that support it and three that complicate it.
2. Replace Identity — If the evidence is mixed, replace identity with a narrower situational description.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Replace Identity, you are done.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Name Appears, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Replace Identity, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Replace Identity, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep only this lesson: Identity claims must show recent action evidence.

📸 MY RESULT

Rigid beliefs, labels & stories

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Global Labels Need Three Receipts is a tiny mind game for the moment when one label is trying to describe the whole person or situation.

GOAL
Identity claims must show recent action evidence.

GAME MOVE
Run the sequence once. Name Appears opens it; Replace Identity closes it.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 GLOBAL LABELS NEED THREE RECEIPTS // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Name Appears — When ‘I’m lazy,’ ‘I’m unlovable,’ or another global Name appears, demand three specific behaviours from the last month that support it and three that complicate it.
2. Replace Identity — If the evidence is mixed, replace identity with a narrower situational description.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Replace Identity, you are done.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Name Appears, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Replace Identity, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Replace Identity, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep only this lesson: Identity claims must show recent action evidence.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
By Replace Identity, the first reaction is no longer the only move on the table.

📸 MY RESULT
“A label was one description, not the whole identity.”

FORMULA FLOW
Name Appears → Replace Identity

Symbolic completion can end a language loop without rewriting facts.

GAME MOVE
Take the shortest route: Picture Words → the middle moves → Add Response.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 SAY THE SENTENCE HISTORY NEVER RECEIVED // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Picture Words — Picture the exact words you could not say or hear.
2. Speak Empty — Speak them to an empty room, page, or object while clearly stating that this is present-day completion, not a changed past.
3. Add Response — Add the response current-you can now provide.

⚡ END MOVE — Add Response. No second lap.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Just before you start Picture Words, notice one sound in the room before continuing.
2. At Speak Empty, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Add Response, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Take this line with you: Symbolic completion can end a language loop without rewriting facts.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 ENTER THROUGH A RANDOM DOOR // PLAY
Stay with the sequence. You do not need to improve it.

1. Number Doors — Name three to six task sections that can safely be done in any order and give each one a number.
2. Imagine One — Use a die, shuffled slips, or a random picker to Imagine one number. No redraw for preference.
3. Enter There — Work only inside that section for ninety seconds; do not reorganise the whole project.
4. Progress — Leave one visible progress Notice, then decide whether to Imagine again or stop.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Progress and leave the game there.

HOOK

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Tomorrow’s low-motivation self should inherit a nearly finished start.

GAME MOVE
Start at Prepare Requirement. Stop at Ready. Let the middle do the work.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 SET UP WHILE ENERGY IS CHEAP // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Prepare Requirement — During a higher-energy window, prepare every requirement: pack, remember in, charge, open, measure, place, or prefill.
2. Leave Final — Leave only the final movement for the difficult time.
3. Ready — Photograph or Notice the ready state.

⚡ FINISH — Ready closes the round.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Prepare Requirement, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Leave Final, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Ready, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: Tomorrow’s low-motivation self should inherit a nearly finished start.

items.text_default:
ENTER THROUGH THE SIDE DOOR

TRIGGER
Action avoidance & procrastination

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Enter Through The Side Door is a tiny mind game for the moment when your mind keeps delaying the first move.

GOAL
Resistance may accept a neighbouring move.

GAME MOVE
Give yourself one clean run: Choose A Side Step first, Let It Lead last.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 ENTER THROUGH THE SIDE DOOR // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Choose A Side Step — Pick a small action beside the main task: open one file before starting the work, put on walking shoes before deciding to walk, or wash one ingredient before cooking.
2. Let It Lead — Start with that small step and let it naturally lead into the main task.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Let It Lead, you are done.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Choose A Side Step, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Let It Lead, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Let It Lead, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep only this lesson: Resistance may accept a neighbouring move.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
By Let It Lead, the first reaction is no longer the only move on the table.

📸 MY RESULT
“I stopped waiting to feel ready and found one move I could do.”

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 PUT THE FIRST OBJECT IN THE PATH // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Identify Object — Spot the first object the desired behaviour requires.
2. Position — Position it where normal movement will encounter it at the right time.
3. Remove Competing — Remove competing cues from that path.
4. Meet — When you meet the object, perform the linked first action before walking past.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Meet and release the exercise.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MAP THE RELATIONSHIP LABOUR // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Plan Carries — Across a defined period, tally who initiates, accommodates, repairs, plans, and carries emotional follow-up.
2. Add Context — Add context for genuine capacity differences.
3. Use Categories — Discuss the pattern using categories, not accusations, and request one clear rebalance.

⚡ FINISH — Use Categories closes the round.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Plan Carries, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Add Context, separate what you know from what you are predicting.
3. When you reach Use Categories, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Imbalance becomes negotiable after it becomes visible.

items.game_move: Start at Plan Carries. Stop at Use Categories. Let the middle do the work.
items.how_to_play:
🎮 MAP THE RELATIONSHIP LABOUR // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Plan Carries — Across a defined period, tally who initiates, accommodates, repairs, plans, and carries emotional follow-up.
2. Add Context — Add context for genuine capacity differences.
3. Use Categories — Discuss the pattern using categories, not accusations, and request one clear rebalance.

⚡ FINISH — Use Categories closes the round.
items.power_up_1: Before you begin Plan Carries, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
items.power_up_2: At Add Context, separate what you know from what you are predicting.
items.power_up_3: When you reach Use Categories, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Imbalance becomes negotiable after it becomes visible.
items.win_reward_raw:
🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can reach Use Categories with more choice than you had at Plan Carries.

📸 MY RESULT
“I put the missing context back into the picture.”
items.formula_flow_raw: Plan Carries → Add Context → Use Categories

TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
If your body alarm keeps turning itself up, Find The Moment The Floor Catches You turns the mental noise into one playable move.
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Panic can obscure support that never disappeared.

GAME MOVE
Play from Shift Weight to Finish Centre. Treat the last move as the finish line.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 FIND THE MOMENT THE FLOOR CATCHES YOU // PLAY
Play it once. No bonus analysis.

1. Shift Weight — Stand safely and shift weight slowly left, centre, right, then forward and back.
2. Identify Instant — At each transition, spot the exact instant the receiving foot supports you.
3. Finish Centre — Finish at centre and name the strongest contact point.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Finish Centre and release the exercise.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Shift Weight, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Identify Instant, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Finish Centre, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Use this as the exit rule: Panic can obscure support that never disappeared.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 BORROW STILLNESS FROM THE WALL // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Rest Gaze — Rest your gaze on a stable line, corner, or heavy object.
2. Compare Visual — Compare its visual constancy with the motion inside your body and mind.
3. Dont Match — Do not make the inner movement match.
4. Let Facts — Let both facts coexist until the outer reference becomes usable.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Let Facts be enough.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Rest Gaze, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At Dont Match, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Let Facts, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Let an unmoving object prove that movement is not the whole field.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Urgency shrinks when hearing regains depth.

GAME MOVE
One round only: enter at Identify Nearest, finish at Let Far.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 SORT THE SOUNDS BY DISTANCE // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Identify Nearest — Spot the nearest sound, one mid-distance sound, and the farthest audible layer.
2. Move Attention — Move attention outward through those distances, then back once.
3. Let Far — Let the far sound widen the perceived space around the closest one.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Let Far and release the exercise.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Identify Nearest, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Move Attention, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Let Far, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Take this line with you: Urgency shrinks when hearing regains depth.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 GIVE THE FINGERS A HARDER PROBLEM // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Find Safe — Find a safe textured object.
2. Explore — Explore ridges, grain, temperature, resistance, transitions, and imbalance with precise fingertips.
3. Name Details — Name details that require fresh sensory discrimination.
4. Continue Description — Continue until the description can no longer be generated automatically.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Continue Description and leave the game there.

2. At Name Details, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Continue Description, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The round ends on this idea: Complex texture can interrupt low-information mental repetition.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 FIND THE SENSE FACT THE STORY CANNOT EXPLAIN // PLAY
Play the moves, not the whole life story.

1. State Fear — State the feared scenario.
2. Search Sensory — Search for one sensory fact opposite with it: an unlocked exit, ordinary background conversation, relaxed posture nearby, intact support, current silence.
3. Predict Fact — Explain in one line why the model fails to predict that fact.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Predict Fact, you are done.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
See what the options look like before their names start campaigning.

GAME MOVE
Move through the sequence once, from Mask Names to Reveal Options.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 HIDE THE OPTION NAMES // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Mask Names — Ask someone—or a shuffled Notice—to rename the leading options A, B and C without showing which is which.
2. Choose Traits — Choose three relevant traits, such as cost, time, fit, reliability, or learning. Keep safety facts visible.
3. Rank Blind — Compare the symbols on those traits without guessing their identities and Hold the current order.
4. Reveal Options — Reveal the names. Keep the blind order or name exactly what Name changed it and why.

⚡ FINISH — Reveal Options closes the round.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Mask Names, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Rank Blind, separate what you know from what you are predicting.
3. When you reach Reveal Options, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: See what the options look like before their names start campaigning.

📸 MY RESULT
“I stopped measuring my whole life against one snapshot.”

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
At Receive Support, you have at least one option the first reaction did not show you.

📸 MY RESULT
“I just left one question unanswered and stayed okay enough.”

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 SOFTEN BOTH SIDES OF SEEING // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Choose Simple — Choose a simple object or sound.
2. Attend Time — Attend at the same time to its qualities and the act of perceiving.
3. Place Reality — Refuse to place all reality on either side.
4. Let Relationship — Let the relationship event—seeing or hearing—become primary for several seconds.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Let Relationship, you are done.
